sv.title: Tre fartyg attackerade i Hormuz
sv.summary: Minst tre tankfartyg har på lördagen angripits i eller i närheten av Hormuzsundet. Iran visar samtidigt upp en ny robotramp i statligt kontrollerad tv.

en.title: Three ships attacked in Hormuz
en.summary: At least three tankers were attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday. Iran meanwhile showed off a new missile salvo on state-controlled television.
